shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION through glass; a pane is a WINDOW (flood-unfogs below). Orders through glass = orders through air.
- Selection survives column view switches. Mountain rivers MOVE, not duplicate. River flow data optional (terrain-keyed gen).
- Pocket maps: celestial/climate reads resolve through the GROUND map; underground levels set disableSkyLighting.
- **Pocket-level fog meshes can bake stale (gen clears the grid post-bake without dirtying); LevelComp self-heals with a one-shot WholeMapChanged(FogOfWar) on first view per session.**
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop + AB_Skylight (glass, dontRender).

## LIVE TEST ROUND 6 RESOLUTION (2026-07-24) — the "all fog + no stairs" report fully decoded via basement diagnostic
Trace: biome=AB_Underground (def loaded ✓), gen=AB_Basement, linkUp ✓, drawerReady ✓, **stairs 0/0 both sides**, **fog DATA 0/62500 (0%)**, granite at center.
1. **"All fog of war" = STALE FOG SECTION MESHES over a fully-clear grid.** The all-fogged bake from map birth never regenerated (gen clears fog without per-cell Unfog). It was ALWAYS stale — but rendered black-on-black under the old sky-multiplied fog color, so nobody saw it; disableSkyLighting restored fog's true gray and unveiled it, framing the biome fix. FIX: LevelComp one-shot fog-mesh heal (locked decision above). Dev "clear fog" had "no effect" because the data was already clear.
2. **"No stairs" was literal truth, not regression**: fresh test columns never had stairs — earlier rounds the user built them manually. FIX: the ensure dev tool now spawns starter stairwells (surface-side AB_StairsDown/AB_StairsUp via the production SpawnCounterpartOn pairing path) whenever a link is missing.
3. Biome fix (disableSkyLighting) VINDICATED — loaded, correct, and the black-basement mechanism stands as diagnosed in round 5.

## VERIFICATION LEDGER
- **RMB cross-level: USER-VERIFIED** (selection preservation + ReplayFresh).
- Black basements: root-caused (missing disableSkyLighting) + fixed; fog-mesh staleness follow-up fixed (this round). AWAITING final visual confirm.
- Rivers: flow-optional rework built; AWAITING fresh-column verification (river diagnostic expects carved/dried counts + wet-under-mass=0).
- Skylight daylight below: shaft ground-map sun fix + pane fog reveal built; AWAITING under-pane light-diagnostic confirm.
- Below lighting from above, direct-to-blueprint, animal flow, BAM, Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke: queued behind the above.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (now spawns starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic (biome/stairs/fog%/links/drawer) · AB: river diagnostic (genstep LastSummary + live counts) · AB: light diagnostic (glow/sun/glowers/shaft chain) · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## FEATURE LEDGER (as documented passes 9-14)
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting · animal flow (scribed pet returns, wild hard-overdue) · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit · Batch D skylights + mountain rivers (superseding, flow-optional) · Batch A verified · B/C built pending · logistics/areas/combat/settings unchanged.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (15th pass): **round-6 trace decoded — stale fog mesh self-heal + starter stairs in the ensure tool built compile-green; biome fix vindicated**. Round 7 = full verification sweep (basement visuals, rivers, skylight daylight).
